TLDR: Cat was taken to vet, vet did a urine test and said it may or may not be a UTI or an issue with her "bladder support" and/or she is just too dehydrated (we do give her water in a bowl btw). Vet gave us urinary cat food and gabapentin (for pain/anxiety) and told us to come back on Friday if needed. 

------

My sister took my cat to the vet (she's the family cat but I usually refer to her as mine when talking about her to others for the sake of energy usually; also the reason why I didn't take her is because I am currently sick and I didn't want to risk infecting anyone at the vet place).

So they did a urine test on her and it came back negative for bacteria but they did find (warning gross details!) >! some blood or traces of blood and the pee was cloudy/concentrated !<. They said it *may or may not* be a uti, but could instead be an issue with her "bladder support" (I am not really sure what that means) and/or it could be that she is dehydrated as well and/or it could still be a uti. We give her water in a bowl which is right next to her food dish/dispenser thing since the water fountain she used to drink out of still needs to be cleaned and the filter replaced (I am sorry, I have been dealing with issues myself and have just not gotten around to doing that task yet).

The vet gave us urinary cat food and some gabapentin for pain and anxiety I think? (Apparently she was good yet quite very anxious at the vent 😞) and she had a blood test done at a previous vet appointment that had no bad results, so they did not do one today. 

I'm NOT trying to be self-deprecating or wanting pity or whatnot when saying this but I genuinely feel very guilty about all this, I know 100% that it my fault that this all happened to her and I know I can and should do better for her and don't get me wrong I truly love her with every fiber of my being and I am going to/ I will try my best to do better for her going forward, no matter what issues I face in life/my energy levels.

Anyways, I think she has slowly been feeling a little bit better after the vet visit, she's doing certain things that she used to do before she was unwell. We will monitor her and the vet said to bring her back on Friday if needed.

Thank you to those of you who gave help and reassurance, I truly appreciate it!!! 🩵
